description: This file defines various data structures and methods related to handling responses from an AI API, including response parsing, error handling, and streaming response components.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents a generic response from the AI API, containing identifiers, model info, choices, and usage statistics.

classes.name: Choice
classes.description: Represents an individual completion choice within the Response, including index, message, and finish reason.

classes.name: Usage
classes.description: Contains token usage details for a response, including prompt, completion, and total tokens.

classes.name: StreamChunk
classes.description: Represents a chunk of a streaming response with choices.

classes.name: StreamDelta
classes.description: Represents a delta or update within a streaming response, including incremental message content.

classes.name: MessageDelta
classes.description: Represents partial message content in a streaming context, including role and content fields.

classes.name: ErrorResponse
classes.description: Represents an error returned from the API, containing error details.

classes.name: ErrorDetail
classes.description: Contains detailed information about an API error, including message, type, and optional code.

methods.name: Text
methods.description: Returns the message content of the first choice in the response.

methods.name: JSON
methods.description: Parses the response content as JSON into the provided destination object.

methods.name: Into
methods.description: Alias for JSON method, facilitating ergonomic parsing.
